title: App-based multimodal lifestyle-intervention for essential hypertension (HYPE): a decentralized randomised controlled trial
excluded: Quality of life, food literacy and responder categories
population_or_material: The HYPE ITT population with uncontrolled essential hypertension.
requested_items: Main Table 2 observed baseline/week-12 arm means and reported changes; primary MICE-ITT ANCOVA contrasts. Include absolute weight summaries and baseline-relative percentage changes/contrasts, retaining the separately reported effect sizes and their own intervals.
case_specific_rules: Use main Table 2 observed baseline/week-12 summaries and the primary MICE-ITT ANCOVA contrasts. Raw-unit contrasts and standardized d are separate principal statistics with their own CIs; do not assign the CI printed beside d to the raw-unit contrast.
Retain reported point estimates at the selected table precision. Follow-up completers, PP counts, subgroup totals and test df do not establish each observed endpoint denominator.
